instruction: A full shot cinematic still of a grassy outdoor backyard surrounded by green trees. On the left, the woman in the crochet vest (R2) is blindfolded with a peach bandana, holding a wooden bat high and laughing. In the background center, the woman in the pink shirt (R1) laughs and reacts. On the right, the man in the patterned tee (R3) laughs and claps his hands together in excitement. The blindfolded woman holds the wooden bat high after swinging at a red pinata, while her friends stand behind her, laughing and celebrating the moment. The scene is illuminated by bright daylight filtering through the trees.
elements: R2 is the blindfolded participant holding a wooden bat high after swinging at the red pinata
R1 stands behind R2 and laughs/reacts as a friend rather than swinging the bat
R3 stands behind R2 and claps in excitement rather than swinging the bat
R2 wears a peach bandana as a blindfold
A wooden bat is used to strike the red pinata
The scene is a grassy outdoor backyard surrounded by green trees
